newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Post forms holding co. for express service.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Post forms holding co. for express service.

text.p: Deutsche Post AD (DPAG) said it formed a holding company for all its express and special transport services with the aim of improving market penetration.
Chairman of the new subsidiary's, Deutsche Post Express and Transport GmbH, will be Frank Blochmann, former chief of rival TNT in Germany, a statement said.

The holding will oversee three other subsidiaries, including the courier and express firm EMS Kurierpost GmbH, which will shortly be re-named Deutsche Post Express GmbH and logistic oursourcing company Deutsche Post Kontraktlogistik GmbH

The third subsidiary is Netlog GmbH, in future Deutsche Post Transport GmbH, which was bought from TNT this spring and manages parcels transport between the 33 DPAG parcels centres. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
